text: Lurking Shadow in the Solitary Moon
You are taken by Jacky and her friends to a new manor they\nhave prepared. Explore it!
While exploring the manor, Olant and Potumkin go missing.\nYou can only hear voices calling for help...Find them!
You see Olant's cape, but he is nowhere to be seen...\nThen you hear Potumkin's voice.\nSearch the manor and save him!
It seems that Olant and Potumkin's bodies that are made of\nsweets get eaten. Collect the sweets required to restore\nthem!
Someone seems to have stolen the sweets that are the vital\nparts of Olant and Potumkin's bodies. Pin down the culprit!
Neewollah has the sweets that are Olant and Potumkin's vital\nbody parts. Defeat Neewollah to retrieve the sweets to bring\nOlant and Potumkin back!
[[N]]Go the the innermost area of the manor
